english_lines: I shall serve a feast of youth — drink it,
A thousand adventures are in my hands,
It is going to grow the bond,
You too will embrace and hold me,
Dizziness in the gaze — enchantment is this maiden's habit,
Even seeing a body like fruit, why this hesitation?
Two fish are rolling — from the lips,
notes: The triple repetitions `கன்னம் / கிண்ணம் / வண்ணம் / சின்னம்` are retained as repetitions rather than compressed into a polished refrain.
`வலிய வருது பறவை` is kept conservatively as `the bird comes forcefully`; the colloquial source wording is not normalized into a more conventional romantic line.
The paired `two fish / two honeys / two deer / two skies` image-chain is preserved line by line rather than decoded into body-part paraphrases.

translator_notes: The song's erotic-romantic voice depends on repetition, colloquial verbs and a deliberately extravagant sequence of paired images; those remain source-shaped.
This is a literary source-faithful translation, not a singable adaptation.
